name: CaseBrief Legal Analysis
description: A project-only, compilerless UMG sleeve for source-grounded CaseBrief record review, issue spotting, citations, confidence, fallback states, human review, and complete auditability. It does not provide legal advice or independently authorise filings, communications, or other external action.
sourceReferences: UMG Project Starter Kit v1.0 and UMG Sleeve Lab v0.2.
CaseBrief product requirements: clickable narrative depth, potential rights-violation flags, Case Readiness Index, role-based access, and who/what/when auditability.
CaseBrief UMG owner-handoff and host-adoption requirements supplied before this sleeve; implementation details remain host-contract dependent.
